analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 30.7, entering oversold territory, with a 5-day consecutive downtrend. MACD histogram worsened from 0.2418 to -0.2296, strengthening the bearish trend. Trading near the 52-week low of $58.19. ADX at 25.6 indicates a clear trend, but -DI is above +DI, showing bearish pressure. While RSI entering oversold is positive for a buy, considering the worsening MACD, 5-day downtrend, and proximity to the 52-week low, further downside is possible, hence a wait-and-see approach.
